summary: FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 2, 2026, disclosing the termination of Michael B. Lyons, Executive Vice President, Chief Specialized Services and Commercial Officer, following an internal investigation finding Code of Conduct violations. The company stated the conduct did not affect financial reporting, performance, internal controls, strategy, or customer relationships. Responsibilities are transitioning to other executives while a search for a replacement proceeds. This is an abrupt senior officer departure due to misconduct, not a routine event. Watch for potential litigation, executive succession details, and any operational impacts from this leadership change.
